'''Jesse Sibler''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2001 Levittown tournament]] on 22 September 2001 with Old Mains, according to Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2989">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-24-levitown-ny-9-22-01-i-am-pissedd2989/ levitown-ny-9-22-01-i-am-pissed], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 24 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-24-levitown-ny-9-22-01-i-am-pissedd2989/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
